# yottabot_agent (Resource)

A YottaBot agent. Manages the agent definition; agent *runs* are not a Terraform concern.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "yottabot_agent" "repo_auditor" {
  name          = "RepoAuditor"
  description   = "Reviews repository changes and produces concise risk findings."
  status        = "available"
  model         = "claude-opus-5"
  system_prompt = file("${path.module}/prompts/repo_auditor.md")

  tool_ids = [yottabot_mcp_tool.github.id]

  env = {
    LOG_LEVEL = "info"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Agent name. Not required to be unique in the tenant, which is why imports are by UUID.

### Optional

- `data_source_ids` (List of String) Data source UUIDs available to the agent.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `env` (Map of String) Environment variables. Keys must match `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$`.
- `guardrail_policy_ids` (List of String) Guardrail policy UUIDs applied to the agent.
- `model` (String) Model name the runner reads.
- `prompt_id` (String) Prompt UUID owning the rendered prompt body. **Removing this forces replacement**: the API's update route cannot clear it (an empty value means "preserve"), so an in-place removal would diff forever.
- `secret_ids` (List of String) Secret UUIDs the runner resolves at boot. References only — no secret value is stored in state.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status: `draft`, `available`, or `unavailable`. Defaults to `draft` server-side. Left out of config, the platform's current value is adopted — publishing an agent from the UI does not then show as drift.
- `system_prompt` (String) System prompt body. Line endings are normalized to `\n`, so a CRLF file does not diff against an LF one.
- `tags` (String) Tags, as the single string the current API stores (not a list).
- `tool_ids` (List of String) Tool catalog UUIDs available to the agent.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID. This is the import id.
- `model_id` (String) Model catalog UUID, when the agent is bound to one. Read-only: writes flow through model credentials, not through this route.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification timestamp.
- `orchestrator_id` (String) Orchestrator (Yotta Graph) UUID. Read-only: SaaS assigns it, and a value that disagrees is rejected server-side, so it is not an input.
- `user_id` (String) UUID of the linked `kind='agent'` user minted at create.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Agents are imported by UUID. Names are not unique within a tenant, so a
# name-based import would be ambiguous.
terraform import yottabot_agent.repo_auditor 0f8c1e6a-2b7d-4a91-9f3e-5c2d8b1a4e77
```
